name: Daily Present
query:
select a.*,b.*,c.*,d.* from 
(select branch,status,count(0) as "total:float" from `tabEmployee` where status='Active' group by branch,status) a 
inner join 
(select plant as "branch",count(*) as "present:float" from (select distinct plant,employee from `tabEmployee Checkin` where time>=curdate()) g group by branch) b on a.branch=b.branch and a.status='Active'
left outer join
(select count(0) as "leave:float",plant from `tabLeave Application` where from_date=curdate() group by plant) c on a.branch=c.plant
left outer join
(select count(0) as "od:float",plant from `tabAttendance Request` where from_date=curdate() group by plant) d on a.branch=d.plant
